* You MUST be authenticated on GitHub Packages, otherwise this project CANNOT resolve it's Maven dependencies.
* Keep changes as absolutely minimal as possible without compromising readability and maintainability.
* Performance related PRs must be easily replicable without requiring execution of code outside the PR and avoid basic pitfalls like low sample size.
* To every commit message body, pull request body and PR/issue comment that you create, you MUST add "generated by AGENT_NAME | MODEL_NAME (if known)", for example "generated by OpenCode  | GLM-5.3-Flash", also you must be commit co-author as AI-agent.
* If a PR warrants a major version increase due to public API change, clearly note that.
* All PRs you create MUST fulfil our checks: code compiles, tests succeed, code is formatted via `google-java-format --skip-reflowing-long-strings`.
